seo.title: VH Billing Suite | Point of sale for any shop
seo.description: Billing for any shop where the price is a conversation. Set your own item details, HSN codes and sticker design. Agreed prices, GST taken out of the price, credit and dues, remote printing and the 9 PM cash count.
seo.shareTitle: VH Billing Suite | The price is a conversation. Your till should keep up.
seo.shareDescription: A point of sale for any shop, set up your way: item details, HSN codes, stickers, agreed prices, GST, credit and the 9 PM cash count.

hero.eyebrow: A point of sale you set up for your own shop
hero.body: VH Billing Suite is a point of sale for any shop that bills at a counter: clothes, groceries, hardware, gifts. We built it at our own saree shop in Surat, then made the shop-specific parts yours to set. It knows about agreed prices, GST taken out of the price, udhaar, price stickers and the 9 PM cash count, so the shop never waits on the software.
hero.aside: Go on, haggle with it. The GST and change are worked out for real.
hero.pickerLabel: Try it as a shop that sells

day.title: A day at the counter.
day.body: Software is easier to judge by what it does between opening and closing. Here is a day at one counter, one job at a time. Keep scrolling and the clock on the wall keeps time. Pick a different kind of shop above and the samples change with it.

scenes.title: The till walks around the shop with you.
scenes.lead: Open the app on any phone and it lands on the scanner. Scan a sticker at the rack and the item shows up on the till at the counter, live.

points.text: Set it per item, or type what the customer settled on for the whole bill and the lines adjust to match.
Set one aside when someone else walks in. They stay on that phone until you come back.
Bills made offline wait on the phone and sync when the connection returns.

scenes.title: Save on the phone. It prints at the counter.
scenes.lead: The bill goes to the shop's printer, not the phone's. If no till is open, it waits its turn and prints when one is.

points.text: They paginate, and the last page keeps the totals and the stamp together.
An unpaid bill shows what is due, with a UPI QR to pay it.
that opens the shop's WhatsApp, so the next visit starts with a message.

scenes.title: Or skip the paper. Send the bill as a link.
scenes.lead: Every bill has its own page. Send it on WhatsApp and the customer sees the itemised bill, stamped, and can download a PDF or message the shop.

points.text: Bill number, total and the PAID or CREDIT stamp show before the link is opened.
It is a web page, so it opens in whatever browser the customer already has.
Bills saved from the phone can be shared the same way.

scenes.title: The wholesaler's bill, photographed.
scenes.lead: Take a photo of the supplier's bill and let the app read it. Nothing is saved until you have looked at every field.

points.text: Fields the reader is unsure of say Check, and missing ones say Not found, so you know where to look.
Credit is 60 days unless you change it for that supplier. Part payments and cheque details are noted.
A ledger statement per supplier, and input tax credit adds up in Reports under Purchases.

scenes.title: Stickers that match the shelf.
scenes.lead: Design the label once, with the shop name, barcode, QR and a big price. Then queue stickers for whatever came in today.

points.text: Every part of the label is a layer you can place, resize and restyle.
See how many stickers are going out, product by product, before the printer starts.
The barcode and QR are what the phone scanner reads at the counter.

scenes.title: Who owes what, and a polite nudge.
scenes.lead: Anything not paid at the counter becomes credit against a name and a phone number. By evening you can see the dues and message each customer from the same screen.

points.text: Each one is noted and the balance carries on.
Pick the wording in Hinglish or English and send it on WhatsApp, one tap at a time.
Dues are grouped by phone number, so a customer is never split in two.

scenes.title: Count the drawer. Close the day.
scenes.lead: At 9 PM the phone reminds you. Count the cash, say how much goes home, and the app works out what stays in the shop for tomorrow.

points.text: before you save, and asks once more if you save anyway.
With pay-outs, a monthly view, and a copy of the day to paste anywhere.
Undo it and count again.

scenes.title: Quarter-end, without the shoebox.
scenes.lead: Prices include GST at the rate of each item's HSN code, so the report takes the tax out of every bill and splits it into CGST and SGST. Pick the quarter and the figures are already there.

points.lead: Files for the portal or your accountant.
points.text: GSTR-1 JSON, a printable summary and CSVs in the offline tool's layout.
missing bill numbers, items on the default HSN, returns netted off.
regular or composition. The page follows whichever you choose.

yours.title: Any counter. Your settings.
yours.body: It started at a saree shop, but nothing in the till is tied to cloth. What an item is, how it is taxed and what goes on its sticker are all yours to set. Pick a kind of shop and watch the samples change.

tabs.label: Item details
tabs.title: Keep the details your goods have.
tabs.text: Each item can carry details of your own, such as a brand, a pack size or a warranty. They show on the item form and can be printed on stickers.

tabs.label: GST and HSN
tabs.title: Your GSTIN, your codes, your rates.
tabs.text: Enter your own GSTIN and state, keep a list of HSN codes with a rate for each, and pick one per item. A rule can set it from a word in the item's name.

tabs.label: Stickers
tabs.title: Design the label your shelf needs.
tabs.text: Pick the label size, then place the name, price, barcode and QR wherever you like. Add values of your own: a formula, a counter, a date or fixed words.

tabs.label: Shop values
tabs.title: Say who you are once.
tabs.text: Your name, tagline, phone, WhatsApp link and UPI ID are saved once and used on stickers and in the messages you send customers.

yours.fixedText: the layout of the printed bill, the QR on it and the payment types (cash, UPI and credit). Its address, terms and logo are on their way as settings. If your shop needs something else, tell us what.

shelf.title: Small things that keep a counter moving.
shelf.body: The day above is the headline. These are the quieter parts that stop you reaching for a notebook.

swatches.title: Split payments
swatches.text: Cash, UPI and credit on one bill. Whatever is not paid becomes credit against a name and a number.

swatches.title: UPI QR for the exact due
swatches.text: A bill with a balance carries a QR for that amount. It works with any UPI app.

swatches.title: The Counter
swatches.text: Goods coming back? Take them in as an exchange or a credit note, with a slip to hand over.

swatches.title: Stock count
swatches.text: Count the shelf on the phone. Items showing negative stock are sorted out in one place.

swatches.title: The books
swatches.text: Sales, products, stock, customers, purchases, a ledger and a trial balance, all from the same bills.

swatches.title: Customer history
swatches.text: Every bill and payment for a customer on one page, with what they still owe.

swatches.title: Numbers by financial year
swatches.text: Bill numbers restart each April. Gaps are pointed out before you file GST.

swatches.title: Install it
swatches.text: Add it to the home screen and it opens full screen, like any other app.

wired.title: Your counter, wired.
wired.body: No special hardware and nothing to buy from us. This is the whole list, and it is what runs our own counter.

links.title: A phone
links.text: Any phone with a camera is a scanner and a second till.

links.title: A computer at the counter
links.text: It runs the till. Printing without a dialog box needs Chrome started in kiosk-printing mode.

links.title: A bill printer
links.text: Anything the computer can print to. Ours is a plain HP LaserJet.

links.title: A label printer
links.text: Only for stickers. Ours is a TSC; set its paper to the label size.

wired.noteText: The till and the phone both work without a label printer, and a bill can be sent as a link instead of printed.

pricing.title: Two tags. Pick one.
pricing.body: No hidden fees. Start free and move to Pro when the shop needs it. Ask for a demo and we will help you choose.

faq.title: Asked at the counter.
faq.body: Not here? Send a note and a person answers it.

items.q: Does it work on a phone?
items.a: Yes. The app opens on the scanner on a phone, so you can scan, set the price the customer agreed to and save the bill from the shop floor. Add it to the home screen and it opens full screen like any other app.

items.q: Do I need a barcode scanner?
items.a: No. The phone's camera reads the barcode or QR on your price sticker, and the item appears on the till at the counter.

Save a bill on any device and the print job goes to the printer at your counter. If no till is open, the bill waits and prints as soon as one is. For printing without a dialog box, the counter computer runs Chrome in kiosk-printing mode.
That is what it was built for. Set the agreed price on each item, or type what the customer settled on for the whole bill and the lines adjust to match. The GST is worked out from that price.

Prices include GST, and the report takes it out of each bill and splits it into CGST and SGST. You get a GSTR-1 JSON, a printable summary and CSVs, with checks for missing bill numbers and default HSN codes. Regular and composition schemes are both covered. Have your accountant look over the figures before you file.
Cash, UPI and credit, split across one bill however the customer pays. Anything not paid becomes credit against a name and a 10-digit phone number, and part payments can be added later.

items.q: Where does my data live, and who can see it?
items.a: In a hosted Supabase database, and the till needs a login. The one exception is a bill's share link: anyone who has that link can open that one bill, so send it only to the customer.

items.q: Is it only for saree shops?
items.a: No. It was built at one, but billing, stock, stickers and reports work for any shop that bills at a counter. Pick another kind of shop at the top of the page to see the till, bill and samples change.

The details kept on each item (add your own, such as brand, pack size or warranty), your GSTIN, HSN codes and rates, the label size and design of your stickers, and your shop name, tagline, phone and UPI ID. The layout of the printed bill, the QR on it and the payment types (cash, UPI and credit) are fixed for now; its address, terms and logo are on their way as settings.

items.q: Does it only suit shops that bargain?
items.a: No. The agreed price starts at the tag price, so a fixed-price shop can leave it alone and bill as normal.

items.q: Can I try it before I ask?
items.a: Yes. The till near the top of this page uses the same maths as the real one. For the full app, ask for a demo and we will show you around.

footer.title: The shop is open. Come in.
footer.body: See the till on your own counter. Ask for a demo and we will walk you through a day, or open the till and look around.
footer.tagline: VH Billing Suite, a point of sale for any counter, built at a saree shop in Surat.
